claims.claim: STLD links recycled/raw steel inputs, domestic steelmaking and downstream fabrication to infrastructure, manufacturing and data-center construction needs.
Vertical integration can improve input resilience, but backlog margin, scrap/input spreads, fabrication pass-through and aluminum qualification are successor bottlenecks.

factors.name: crossDivisionLeverage
factors.basis: Recycling, steelmaking and fabrication connect input access with downstream demand.

factors.name: scenarioRobustness
factors.basis: Diversification broadens exposure while cyclicality and startup execution remain material.

risks.risk: Input-cost transmission can weaken fabrication economics even when backlog volume is strong.

causalEdges.mechanism: construction requires structural steel and fabrication
causalEdges.falsifier: backlog cancels or converts at uneconomic margins

causalEdges.mechanism: scrap access can improve supply control
causalEdges.falsifier: scrap/input spreads deteriorate enough to erase integration benefit

unknowns.unknown: Margin embedded in fabrication backlog and normalized aluminum economics.

claims.claim: Expanded fabrication backlog does not by itself prove economic quality because higher steel inputs compressed fabrication operating income.
Aluminum diversification can add resilience only if startup losses and qualification risks resolve into competitive economics.

factors.name: pricingPower
factors.basis: Strong steel pricing can coexist with downstream margin pressure when input costs reset faster than contracts.

factors.name: supplyChainResilience
factors.basis: Vertical integration helps input access but does not eliminate spread/cycle exposure.

risks.risk: Cyclicality, trade-policy sensitivity, backlog quality and aluminum startup execution can weaken returns.

causalEdges.mechanism: cost inflation compresses contract economics unless repricing/pass-through compensates
causalEdges.falsifier: sustained pass-through protects margins through input volatility

contradictions.claim: Strong pricing/backlog coexist with fabrication margin pressure.
contradictions.resolution: Backlog volume and economic quality are distinct; margin pressure is a present risk but not a falsification of end demand.

unknowns.unknown: Backlog cancellation/margin quality, data-center share and normalized aluminum profitability.
